title: Create and edit a request
requirement: Requesters shall create requests (title, legal entity, currency, chart of account, requested for, organisation unit, project, need-by date, fiscal period, ship-to location, notes, custom fields, attachments) as Draft and edit them in Draft or Rejected; editing in other states is refused.
acceptance_criteria: Given mandatory header fields, When saved, Then a Draft exists without a number.|Given a request in approval, When edited, Then it is refused with the state named. (error case)|Given a rejected request edited and resubmitted, When processed, Then a new approval chain is built.

title: Request lines and lots
requirement: Lines (item or free text, type product or service, quantity or amount basis, quantity, unit, unit price, currency, supplier suggestion, category, need-by, ship-to, custom fields) and lots with child lines, numbered per request, with a duplicate rule on item plus supplier plus account coding plus ship-to.
acceptance_criteria: Given a complete line, When saved, Then it gets the next line number and the request total updates.|Given a duplicate line, When saved, Then it is refused with the duplicate named. (error case)|Given a lot, When child lines are added, Then the lot total equals the sum of children.

title: Account splits on lines
requirement: Each line shall be split across account strings with budget period and percent per the account split rule; a default split from the requester's organisation unit shall be proposed.
acceptance_criteria: Given splits of 60 and 40 percent, When submitted, Then validation passes.|Given splits totalling 90 percent, When submitted, Then "Allocations for line N total 90 percent; they must total 100" is shown. (error case)|Given a default split configured, When a line is created, Then it is pre-filled and editable.

title: Line currencies and conversion
requirement: When multi-currency lines are allowed, lines may be in allowed currencies and are converted to the header currency with the rate valid on the request date; the request shows both amounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a line in USD and header in INR, When saved, Then the converted amount uses the valid rate.|Given no rate, When saved, Then it is refused naming the pair and date. (error case)|Given multi-currency off, When editing, Then only the header currency is offered.

title: Submission validations
requirement: On submit the system shall validate header mandatory fields, at least one line, mandatory line fields, splits totalling 100 percent, supplier status (published, not on hold, no critical flag, no blocking expired document), item status, budget period open, and run hook points; it shall then allocate the number and start the approval chain (or approve directly when no configuration applies).
acceptance_criteria: Given a complete request, When submitted, Then it is numbered and In Approval (or Approved).|Given a supplier on hold on a line, When submitted, Then it is refused naming the line and supplier. (error case)|Given a hook that blocks, When submitted, Then the message is shown and the request stays Draft.

title: Budget check at submission
requirement: Submission shall apply the budget availability check with reservation (BF-065) when request budget validation is on, blocking or warning as configured, and show approvers the budget status per split.
acceptance_criteria: Given blocking on and budget short, When submitted, Then it is refused with the shortfall per account string. (error case)|Given warning on, When submitted, Then it proceeds and the approval screen shows the shortfall.|Given validation off, When submitted, Then no budget check runs and no reservation is made. (edge)
notes: Was FF-055. AC1 is marked as the error case it is (ADR-0041).

title: Approval of requests
requirement: Requests shall use the kernel workflow with the request document type, conditions on header, line and split fields (amount, category, legal entity, supplier, account string, custom fields), dynamic approvers (manager chain, budget owner, account string owner, category group) and the standard actions; approvers shall see lines, splits, budget status and attachments in the approval view.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configuration on amount above 10,000 with manager chain, When submitted, Then the requester's manager is an approver.|Given a rejection, When done, Then the requester is notified and may edit.|Given an approver who is also the requester and self-approval is disallowed, When they try, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Cancel a request
requirement: The requester or a permitted user shall cancel a request in Draft, In Approval or Approved without orders, with a reason, releasing budget reservations and notifying pending approvers.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Approved request without orders, When cancelled, Then it is Cancelled and reservations released.|Given a request with an order, When cancelled, Then it is refused; close-short is offered instead. (error case)|Given cancellation, When audited, Then the reason is recorded.

title: Request totals and summary
requirement: Requests shall show line totals, converted totals in header currency, tax estimate when codes are set, budget status per split, linked orders and a summary panel for approvers.
acceptance_criteria: Given lines in two currencies, When viewed, Then the total is in header currency with the rates used.|Given linked orders, When viewed, Then order numbers and statuses are listed.|Given no rate for a line, When totals compute, Then the total shows as unavailable with the reason instead of a wrong number. (error case)

title: Convert a request to orders
requirement: A buyer shall convert an Approved request into one draft order per supplier (default) with the option to split or merge lines across orders before submission; lines without supplier must be assigned a supplier first; converted lines are linked and the request becomes Partially Ordered or Ordered.
acceptance_criteria: Given approved lines for two suppliers, When converted, Then two draft orders exist and the request is Ordered.|Given a line without supplier, When converted, Then it is refused naming the line. (error case)|Given only some lines converted, When saved, Then the request is Partially Ordered with remaining quantities visible.
notes: Was FF-058. Converting publishes an event that Orders, a later product, handles by creating the draft orders; Orders publishes the orders it created, and this product marks the lines and the request Partially Ordered or Ordered when it hears of them (ADR-0042). Decision F-01 confirmed.

title: Partial ordering and close-short
requirement: Remaining quantities on request lines shall be orderable later; a buyer or requester shall close a request or line short with a reason, releasing remaining budget reservation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a line of 10 with 6 ordered, When viewed, Then 4 remains orderable.|Given close-short, When applied, Then the remaining 4 is released and the line is Closed.|Given a closed line, When conversion is attempted, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Copy and templates
requirement: Users shall copy a request into a new draft and save requests as personal or shared templates; templates pre-fill header and lines without numbers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a copy, When created, Then lines and splits are copied as a new Draft.|Given a template used, When created, Then the request is Draft with template lines.|Given a template with an inactive item, When used, Then the line is flagged for review. (edge)|Given a template shared by a user without the share permission, When saved, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Request lists and visibility
requirement: Lists of requests with filters (status, requester, unit, period, supplier, amount) shall respect visibility: requesters see their own and those requested for them, buyers see their units, approvers see those they act on, administrators see all.
acceptance_criteria: Given a requester, When listing, Then only their requests appear.|Given a buyer scoped to unit A, When listing, Then requests of unit A and children appear.|Given a user without any request permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)

title: Operational reports
requirement: The reports in section 11.3 shall be available as grids with filters, saved views and export, respecting permissions and visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user without the reports permission, When opening, Then it is refused. (error case)|Given export, When run, Then the file matches the grid.
notes: Was FF-160, the request reports; the others are ORD-081, RCV-101, INV-084 and CAT-041. Placed by the test: each product owns its reports.
